messages.subject: Project Harbor — report on title
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Isla,

Our report on title is attached. In summary, a good and marketable title at the agreed price. Four matters for your attention: the outstanding Penrose rent review (we suggest a £15k retention), the 2026 Harbourside break, the informal parking with No. 9, and discharge of the Seller's bank charge on completion (handled by undertaking). Flood: the building sits in Zone 2 by virtue of the waterfront, mitigated by defences and insurance.

Happy to talk it through ahead of the board meeting.

Sarah

—
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
